name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.2 Port)
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. A rework of enchantment progression: you can now enchant your gear using enchanted books placed in nearby chiseled bookshelves using a chiseled enchanting table.

custom.chiseled_enchanting_table:port_notes: Unofficial community port to Minecraft 26.2. 1.1.0 layers the full 26.1.2-line content on top of the 26.3-synced baseline - the progression/economy/UI overhaul plus the 2026-10-23 follow-up batch (illustrated Arcane Grimoire manual with JEI/REI lookup from every page slot, dual-tab Inscribe/Cleanse console with free XP-refunding disenchant and step-down, Cleansing Grit single-trait stripping, curse purging, incremental upgrade discounting, anti-arbitrage conservation proven over maxLevel 1..255 by a compiled JUnit 5 suite, live 1-second shelf rescan, and the de-hardcoded library_resonance.json / shelf_gates.json / disenchanting.json configuration): two-track library progression over the 7x5x7 volume (wooden bookshelves up to ceil(maxLevel/2) plus a >=12-shelf XP-discount floor; stored Master Tomes in chiseled bookshelves unlock every level 1..k 1:1), relative-mastery Library Resonance (r = level/maxLevel, up to -40% XP), a dual-mode XP formula (vanilla mass-production tiers of 1/2/3 levels for item transformations and Master-Tome inscribing, full curve for base enchanting/upgrades/epiphanies), yield-aware material curves (base_count/max_level_count/level_exponent), Grand Library Treasure Epiphany at >=32 wooden bookshelves with persistent cryo-stasis freeze and reroll, the Depleted Tome + Blank Overwrite cleanse loop, Arcane Catalyst, new recipes (8x Crying Obsidian, table upgrade), 18 advancements across 11 languages, dyeable table rendering with drop-preserved components, stackable-64 enchanted books with a flat anvil prior-work penalty, deepened Mineshaft Efficiency II-V loot, bidirectional JEI/REI lookup for both enchanting and item transformations, and the 26.2-safe UI pass (scissor-clipped rows, bounded text, 1:1 scrollbar drag, painted panels, MM:SS timer). 26.2-specific adaptations: ChatFormatting is gone in 26.2, so every styled line uses Style#withColor(ARGB); the 26.2 structure-processor API (interface + codec(), registered into BuiltInRegistries.STRUCTURE_PROCESSOR), ChunkAccess#markPosForPostProcessing, the plural conditions[]/functions[] loot schema and the recipe_crafted 'recipe_id' criterion are kept; viewers stay pinned to jei-26.2-fabric 30.47.0.239 / RoughlyEnoughItems-api-fabric 26.2.821. Active mixins live in chiseled-enchanting-table-port.mixins.json (9 entries, including the re-enabled flat anvil prior-work penalty). See CURRENT_BASELINE.md, docs/reports/SYNC_FROM_26_1_2_SIDE_REPORT.md for this sync's change-by-change mapping and its 26.2 adaptations, and docs/EXTENDING.md for data-driven customisation entry points.
